title: Deliverability reports
subtitle: What the rest of the internet reports about mail sent in your name.

mailbox.missingTitle: No mailbox is receiving these reports
mailbox.missingBody: Your DNS already asks the world to send reports to {{address}}, but that mailbox does not exist, so they are being rejected. Create it and reports will start appearing here.
mailbox.lastError: The last read of the report mailbox failed: {{reason}}
mailbox.neverScanned: The report mailbox {{address}} has not been read yet.

dmarc.title: Who sends mail as you
dmarc.help: Every address that sent mail carrying your domain in the From header, as reported by the receivers. An address you do not recognise is either a service you forgot about or someone else.
dmarc.empty: No reports have arrived for this period.

tlsrpt.title: TLS sessions
tlsrpt.noFailures: No failed sessions were reported for this period.

mtasts.title: MTA-STS
mtasts.help: MTA-STS tells sending servers that mail for your domain must arrive over verified TLS. It is published in steps because each one waits on DNS and on your certificate.
mtasts.withdrawNotice: The policy is being withdrawn. It stays published as "none" until every sender's cached copy has expired, which can take a week. Removing it sooner would leave senders applying the old policy.

modes.pending_dns: Waiting for DNS to publish the policy host.
modes.pending_cert: Waiting for a certificate that covers the policy host.
modes.testing: Published in testing mode. Senders report mismatches instead of refusing to deliver.
modes.enforce: Published in enforce mode. Senders refuse to deliver over an unverified connection.

steps.dnsWaiting: Waiting for the policy host to resolve to this server.
steps.dnsDone: The policy host resolves to this server.
steps.certWaiting: Waiting for the certificate to cover the policy host.
steps.certDone: The certificate covers the policy host.

reasons.notTesting: Enforce becomes available once the policy is published in testing mode.
reasons.soakIncomplete: Enforce becomes available after the policy has been in testing long enough for the first TLS reports to arrive.
reasons.mxCertificateMissing: Your mail server's certificate does not cover every hostname the policy names. In enforce mode senders would refuse to deliver, without bouncing.

confirmEnforce.title: Switch to enforce?
confirmEnforce.message: Sending servers will refuse to deliver mail to you over a connection they cannot verify, and those messages do not bounce. Only continue if your mail certificate is correct.

confirmWithdraw.title: Withdraw the policy?
confirmWithdraw.message: The policy stays published as "none" until every sender's cached copy has expired, which can take a week. This is deliberate: removing it immediately would leave senders applying the old policy against a server that no longer proves it.

errors.loadFailed: The reports could not be loaded.
errors.modeFailed: The mode could not be changed.
errors.withdrawFailed: The policy could not be withdrawn.
